GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 463.7 (2 Apr 49) GD
(SCAPIN - 1995/2)
APO 500
20 July 1949
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
SUBJECT : Recovery of Waste Petroleum Products.
1, References:
a. Memorandum for the Japanese Government from General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, file AG 463.7 (2 Apr 49)GD, SCAPIN 1995, 22 April 1949, subject: Recovery of Waste Petroleum Products.
b. Memorandum for the Japanese Government from General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, file AG 463.7 (2 Apr 49)GD, SCAPIN 1995/1, 16 May 1949, subject: Recovery of Waste Petroleum Products.
2. Paragraph 2 of reference 1b is rescinded and the following substituted therefor:
"Imported waste petroleum will include all petroleum products, procured by the United States Government, which have been used, or become contaminated while under custody of any authorized agency of said government, add which cannot be utilized for their original purpose or as an acceptable substitute for any other refined petroleum product."
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
